question: Explain the five-step model for revenue recognition under Ind AS 115.

points.label: Identify the contract
points.description: Identify the contract(s) with a customer that meet the criteria (approved, rights and payment terms identifiable, commercial substance, collection probable).

points.label: Identify performance obligations
points.description: Identify each distinct promise to transfer goods or services as a performance obligation.

points.label: Determine the transaction price
points.description: Determine the consideration expected, including variable consideration and the effects of significant financing components.

points.label: Allocate the transaction price
points.description: Allocate the transaction price to each performance obligation based on relative stand-alone selling prices.

points.label: Recognise revenue
points.description: Recognise revenue when (or as) each performance obligation is satisfied, either at a point in time or over time.
